exposure: Family member comments on milk supply
outcome: Prevalence of perceived inadequacy of milk (PIM)
Association between maternal psychological distress and PIM
cohort: 249 mothers during the first week after birth at Colombo North Teaching Hospital, Sri Lanka
finding: The study found that family members telling mothers their milk supply was low was significantly associated with PIM, along with antenatal maternal complications and cesarean section birth.
mod_finding: Cesarean section birth was associated with perceived inadequacy of milk.
